text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Peeking into the lesson room, I saw Aston 
Machan and Daiwa Scarlet in the middle of 
dance practice.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hup... ho, hah—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hawaaah!?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: A-Are you okay!?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mmh, is it really not okay if I just sing 
without dancing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Mmmh... dancing is also part of the 
Winning Live, after all...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Let's try a bit more. Don't worry, you're 
doing way better than earlier!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer? Yes. Chan-Me is doing her 
best.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying my best, but it's just not 
working. For some reason, my legs get all 
tangled whenever I dance.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Watch closely. One, two, three, and four.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Whoa-whoa.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Good grief. Why do my legs always end up 
all tangled up?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Am I rushing it? Maybe I should try 
taking fewer steps?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You're reducing it from what we have now? 
But... it's not like Machan wants to take 
the easy way out...
choice_data_list:
Then why not try increasing it even more 
instead?
Let's take a break and clear your head.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Oh? And what do you mean by that?
choice_data_list:
Because you're better at delicate 
movements.

Because you're better at delicate 
movements,

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I told her that rather than pausing 
between steps, moving to every single beat 
might suit her better.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: In other words, doing this—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Well, well... What do we have here??

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, amazing! You're so much lighter on 
your feet than before!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You really do watch over your Umamusume 
carefully, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I did it. It seems Machan has mastered a 
special move.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With this, I'm one step closer to becoming 
an ultra-super mascot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan had polished her dance steps 
to perfection.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Breaks are indeed important. Commencing 
break now.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Taking a rest cleared my head, and I came 
up with a great idea.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: For instance—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"You use things like this to guide their 
eyes. It's what they call misdirection."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With a flashy item, her mascot power 
increases. Everyone's eyes are glued to 
Chan-chan's upper body.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With this, could I perhaps get away with 
no steps at all?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Misdirection... I see now—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Like hell it does! Jeez, now that you've 
refreshed yourself, let's get back to it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Encouraged by her friend, Aston Machan 
managed to overcome her weakness.
